subject.title: [Data] Quality signals for ClawHub Skills — we analyzed the top 50 and found trust gaps

question: Should ClawHub add a public advisory skill quality score, and which dimensions and downstream effects are allowed separate from security and moderation verdicts?
rationale: Automation cannot decide score authority, public semantics, ranking or install effects, data handling, and security-review boundaries for a new trust signal.

options.title: Define Advisory Model First
options.body: Create a spec for dimensions, provenance, freshness, appeals, and non-security semantics before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into Security Audit
options.body: Treat quality as another audit signal, accepting the risk that users may conflate quality with safety unless copy and UI are very explicit.

options.title: Defer Public Scoring
options.body: Keep current publish gating and security audits, and use the external dataset only as private curation input for now.

recommendation.title: Define Advisory Model First
recommendation.body: Create a spec for dimensions, provenance, freshness, appeals, and non-security semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle owns or reviews the schema, publish, moderation, scanner, and security-doc paths that would define and expose the signal.
